body:
Thanks for the feedback !

> This setting doesn't look related to project manager at all, it shouldn't be a part of anything in the project manager, it should not be added to the quick settings dialog. The setting should be somewhere else like `"text_editor/behavior/general/"`.

I agree this doesn’t belong in the Project Manager or Quick Settings. As mentioned in the proposal, its current placement was only temporary. I wasn’t fully confident whether Text Editor → Behavior or Text Editor → Completion would be more appropriate, so I left it there intentionally to make sure it would be reviewed and relocated properly.
I also asked on rocketchat but didn’t get an answer (or at least didn't saw it), so I’d definitely appreciate your guidance on the best final location.


> It should also work for resources dropped as export variables..

Unless I’m mistaken (it’s been a little while since I worked on this), the current implementation should already handle resources dropped as export variables. I’ve just double-checked the changes and it seems to be covered, but let me know if you’re seeing a case where it doesn’t behave correctly.


> It could also use an enum.

I might be misunderstanding your point here. The option is already implemented as an int enum, similar to the existing directory_naming_convention. If you had something else in mind could you clarify? I’m happy to adjust it accordingly.


Thanks in advance for your answers ! :)
